raw_feedback_text: The plotted GD-VLV + GD-SH + GD-ST layout retrieved the latest KEL evidence path only after review, but the layout itself did not apply the GD-TT/GD-TP + GD-SH C1 evidence to valve placement or shroud dimensions. Retrieval alone is insufficient; the layout/report must show the evidence basis or be marked evidence-not-applied.

structured_feedback.affected_requirement: GD-VLV + GD-SH layouts must apply retrieved C1 shroud-plus-stiff-component evidence to placement and dimensions.
structured_feedback.affected_function: convert retrieved EDIKB evidence into layout-basis checks for shroud V/L1/L2 and stiff-component position
structured_feedback.affected_behavior: prevent plot-valid layouts from appearing design-valid when evidence was retrieved but not used
structured_feedback.affected_structure: GD-VLV; GD-SH; GD-ST top-structure layout context
structured_feedback.affected_constraint: Require evidence refs, shroud dimension basis, stiff-component position basis, shroud region mapping, and applicability limits in design_basis.
structured_feedback.pmap_issue: The previous plot centered the valve and selected shroud dimensions without applying available C1 placement/length evidence.
